programs.title: Nazi Megastructures 6
programs.desc:
Details of military solutions, tactics and technologies used by countries participating in World War II will be presented.The creators will reveal what the German anti-aircraft defense system looked like and will also talk about the Burma Death Railway.Linię, liczącą 415 km, wybudowała Japonia.Its creation resulted in the death of thousands of people, mainly prisoners of war and civilians.Historians will also go on a journey around the Pacific islands, visiting places in Europe and Africa where fierce fighting took place.In the bunkers built on the territory of the Third Reich, you can still find remains of equipment and impressive fortifications.The enormous structures were intended to ensure that Hitler maintained control over the Old Continent
In 1942, the Japanese occupied the oil-bearing areas of Burma to support an economy focused on the war industry.The unsuccessful Battle of Midway forced the creation of a new route for transporting this valuable raw material.In this way, a railway line was created crossing hard-to-reach areas.More than four hundred kilometers of tracks were laid by 200,000 prisoners of war and civilians in extremely difficult conditions, making their way through the jungle.Half of the workers died in accidents, exhaustion and disease.
